title: insufficient funds for gas * price + value
summary: The sender's native-token balance can't cover gasLimit * gasPrice + value.
likelyCauses: Account does not have enough ETH (or chain native token).
value field is too large.
Estimated gasLimit is unusually high.
nextSteps: Fund the sender.
Lower the transaction value or gas price.
Verify you're on the chain you think you are (wrong chainId = wrong balance).

title: intrinsic gas too low
summary: The gasLimit you set is below the EVM's intrinsic cost for the transaction (base 21000 + calldata + access list).
likelyCauses: Hard-coded gasLimit too small.
Forgot to add calldata cost for a contract call.
Access list not accounted for.
nextSteps: Let the provider estimate gas, then bump 10–20% for safety.
If you must hand-roll, compute 21000 + per-byte calldata cost + access-list cost.

title: max fee per gas less than block base fee

patterns.value: max fee per gas less than block base fee

summary: maxFeePerGas is below the current block's base fee. Post-EIP-1559, the tx can never be included until base fee drops or you raise the cap.
likelyCauses: Stale fee suggestion.
Base fee spike between estimation and submission.
Wallet capped the fee for safety.
nextSteps: Refetch base fee (`eth_feeHistory` / latest block) and increase maxFeePerGas above it.
Use 2× base fee + tip as a safe default for fast inclusion.

title: replacement transaction underpriced
summary: You tried to replace a pending tx (same nonce) but the new gas price was not high enough. Most nodes require ~10% bump.
likelyCauses: Replacement fee bump under the node's minimum (typically 10%).
Wallet auto-bumped the priority fee but not the max fee (or vice versa).
nextSteps: Increase both maxFeePerGas and maxPriorityFeePerGas by >= 10%.
If you don't need to replace, wait for the original to land or be dropped.
